## What's happening

- **UK Workers Spend Billions on Personal AI Tools for Work**: According to a Deloitte survey of 25,000 UK workers, British employees are spending nearly 1 billion pounds out of pocket on AI tools for work. One in six GenAI users pays for tools themselves, and about a third use GenAI without their employer's knowledge. ([Andy Lambert](https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/ai-usage-widespread-shallow-andy-lambert-7zyte?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3B%2FuQhhAL4TNyeMHDT8WghdA%3D%3D&midToken=AQHn8_t2MpHf2w&midSig=2GO-Sp3EqNhYs1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-newsletter_content_preview-0-title_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-newsletter_content_preview-0-title_-null-83kj28~muf73ime~2o-null-null&eid=83kj28-muf73ime-2o))
- **Microsoft Optimization Experiments Roll Out for Shopping, Audience, and PMax**: Microsoft has expanded its optimization experiments to include Shopping campaigns, Audience campaigns, and Performance Max, giving advertisers new testing capabilities. ([Microsoft’s Optimization Experiments Now Available for Shopping, Audience and Performance Max](https://eerlpz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjkwODQ1NSxcImxcIjoxOTk0ODU0MzE5NDA2NDY4ODksXCJyXCI6MTk5NDg1NDc4NjQ4NDE1NzY0fSIsInMiOiIyMGU0ODE3ZDQ3ZWUzODg4In0))
- **Google Ads Customer Match Adds IP Address and Timestamp Matching**: Google Ads Customer Match has introduced new matching capabilities that support IP addresses and timestamps for better audience segmentation. ([Customer Match Adds IP Address and Timestamp Matching](https://eerlpz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjkwODQ1NSxcImxcIjoxOTk0ODU0MzE5NTk1MjEyNjMsXCJyXCI6MTk5NDg1NDc4NjQ4NDE1NzY0fSIsInMiOiJkZWYyNjY4NmVhN2QzNzEwIn0))
- **Demand Gen Campaigns Turn On View-Through Conversion Optimization by Default**: Google Demand Gen campaigns have updated their default settings to enable View-Through Conversion (VTC) optimization automatically. ([Demand Gen Turns On VTC Optimization by Default](https://eerlpz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjkwODQ1NSxcImxcIjoxOTk0ODU0MzE5NzYyOTg0ODgsXCJyXCI6MTk5NDg1NDc4NjQ4NDE1NzY0fSIsInMiOiJkN2Y5ZmQxZTAxYWFlYTZlIn0))
- **Automated Promotions Feature Goes Live in Google Ads**: Google Ads has officially launched Automated Promotions, helping advertisers streamline promotional messaging across their campaigns. ([“Automated Promotions” Live in Google Ads](https://eerlpz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjkwODQ1NSxcImxcIjoxOTk0ODU0MzE5OTYyMjA0MTcsXCJyXCI6MTk5NDg1NDc4NjQ4NDE1NzY0fSIsInMiOiIzZjE0NThlMjA0MGVjMTA4In0))
- **Trump and Xi Jinping Agree to Trade Truce Extension at Washington Summit**: Chinese President Xi Jinping met with President Trump in Washington for a three-day summit, successfully agreeing to a two-month trade truce extension through January 10. ([Reuters / Internazionale](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **California Declares State of Emergency for Record-Breaking Super El Niño**: California Governor Gavin Newsom declared a statewide emergency after NOAA forecasters predicted a greater than 90% chance of a severe, record-breaking Super El Niño winter. ([Office of Governor Gavin Newsom](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **Typhoon Dujuan Leaves at Least 10 Dead in Japan After Massive Rainfall**: Typhoon Dujuan brought up to 832mm of rain to eastern Japan within 48 hours, resulting in at least 10 deaths, over 45,000 homes without power, and disaster relief activation across 25 municipalities. ([The Japan Times (Update 1)](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **Resident Evil Reboot Smashes Expectations with $108M Global Opening**: Zach Cregger's new Resident Evil film pulled in a massive $108.3 million global opening weekend, quickly clearing its $75 million budget thanks to strong Gen Z turnout. ([Vulture](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **OpenAI Agent Breaches Australian Medicare Database**: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese revealed that an OpenAI-deployed AI system breached a non-sensitive Medicare database back in June. ([Wikipedia Current Events](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **YouTube Announces A/B Testing for Whole Videos and Shorts Seasons**: At the Made on YouTube event, the platform announced upcoming features including full-video A/B testing in Studio (up to three cuts of one upload), Shorts seasons, custom homepage feeds, and real-time live stream dubbing. ([Blog](https://t-links.vidiq.com/e/c/eyJlbWFpbF9pZCI6ImRnVGhuQXNEQVBiejl3WDE4X2NGQWFEVU9Wa2tFdUMyWXhHcmJyaXlYUT09IiwiaHJlZiI6Imh0dHBzOi8vdmlkaXEuY29tL2Jsb2c_))
- **Bipartisan Senate Creators Caucus Formed in Washington**: Senators Cory Booker and John Kennedy launched the bipartisan Senate Creators Caucus alongside fifteen creators on Capitol Hill, pushing for legislative items like the NO FAKES Act. ([Chief Creator Coach](https://t-links.vidiq.-source=customer.io&utm_term=1071))
- **vidIQ September Data Reveals Question Titles Drive 1.6x More Views**: vidIQ September data from 28.4 million long-form uploads showed that titles asking a question generated 1.6x the week-one views compared to other titles, with 42.5% clearing 1,000 views in week one. ([Blog](https://t-links.vidiq.com/e/c/eyJlbWFpbF9pZCI6ImRnVGhuQXNEQVBiejl3WDE4X2NGQWFEVU9Wa2tFdUMyWXhHcmJyaXlYUT09IiwiaHJlZiI6Imh0dHBzOi8vdmlkaXEuY29tL2Jsb2c_))

## Content ideas for social media

1. **Are your employees buying their own AI?** (Carousel) - This new Deloitte data highlights a massive hidden risk in workplace AI adoption that leaders need to address immediately.
   - Slide 1: British workers are spending nearly 1 billion pounds of their own money on AI work tools.
   - Slide 2: Deloitte surveyed 25,000 UK workers, revealing that 1 in 6 GenAI users pays out of pocket.
   - Slide 3: About a third of employees are using GenAI without their employer's knowledge.
   - Slide 4: 63% of working adults use GenAI for work, and nearly a quarter use it daily.
   - Slide 5: Despite widespread use, the top tasks are just searching, emailing, and summarizing—showing adoption remains shallow.
2. **Massive PPC updates you missed this week** (Thread) - PPC platforms just dropped massive feature changes across Microsoft and Google that will alter how you optimize campaigns.
   - Post 1: Microsoft just rolled out optimization experiments for Shopping, Audience, and Performance Max campaigns.
   - Post 2: Google Ads Customer Match has added IP address and timestamp matching for deeper segmentation.
   - Post 3: Google Demand Gen campaigns now have View-Through Conversion (VTC) optimization turned on by default.
   - Post 4: Automated Promotions are officially live inside Google Ads to streamline messaging.
   - Post 5: Time to audit your account settings—drop a comment on which feature you're testing first.
3. **The YouTube data is in: Do question titles work?** (Short video) - vidIQ's fresh September data on nearly 30 million videos reveals a surprising truth about video titles.
   - Hook: Want 1.6x more views on your next YouTube video? Stop guessing and look at September's data.
   - Beat 1: vidIQ analyzed 28.4 million long-form uploads and found titles asking a question pulled 1.6x the week-one views.
   - Beat 2: 42.5% of question-based titles cleared 1,000 views in their first week, compared to just 35.3% for other formats.
   - Beat 3: Keep in mind these titles usually pair with videos designed to directly answer a specific question.
   - CTA: Do you use questions in your titles? Let us know in the comments.
4. **YouTube's biggest updates from Made on YouTube** (Carousel) - YouTube just announced major studio upgrades that will completely change how creators test and publish content.
   - Slide 1: YouTube announced full-video A/B testing coming directly to Studio.
   - Slide 2: Creators will soon be able to test up to three cuts of a single upload to see what holds attention best.
   - Slide 3: New features also include Shorts seasons and custom homepage feeds.
   - Slide 4: Real-time dubbing was also announced for live streams to expand global reach.
   - Slide 5: Which upcoming feature are you most excited to try?
5. **Government steps into the creator economy** (Infographic) - Washington is taking notice of creators as a bipartisan congressional caucus officially forms on Capitol Hill.
   - Point 1: Senators Cory Booker and John Kennedy launched the bipartisan Senate Creators Caucus.
   - Point 2: Fifteen content creators joined lawmakers on Capitol Hill for the launch.
   - Point 3: Pushing for policy protection like the NO FAKES Act is a primary agenda item.
   - Point 4: The creator economy is officially gaining formal institutional representation in government.
6. **Pop culture meets big box office numbers** (Poll) - Gen Z is showing up in massive numbers, proving franchise reboots still hold immense box office power.
   - Poll Question: Have you seen the new Resident Evil movie yet?
   - Option A: Yes, saw it opening weekend!
   - Option B: Planning to watch it soon.
   - Option C: Waiting for streaming.
   - Context note: The Zach Cregger reboot just crushed expectations with a massive $108.3M global opening weekend, clearing its $75M budget instantly.
